# Tell Projects

> > Tell Projects is a Houston-based home remodeling and construction company serving Greater Houston, TX with comprehensive renovation, ADU construction, and design-build services.

Tell Projects specializes in residential remodeling across Houston neighborhoods including The Woodlands, Sugar Land, Cypress, Pearland, Memorial, and Katy. The company offers full-service construction project management, 3D design visualization, and financing options for kitchen remodels, bathroom renovations, ADU builds, and complete home transformations.

- Houston home remodeling

- Bathroom renovation
- 3D design visualization
